scope: Imported instructions, cross-audience private context, shared execution grants, and expired personal speaker work-result authority.

corrections.telegramGroup: Exact group audience retains its shared conversation and recall. Private action context, effects, and prior action continuation are excluded.
corrections.sharedSpeaker: Only tool routes with explicit audience authority are available. Existing actor grants remain necessary for Home Assistant basic reads and light or switch commands.
corrections.personalWorkReturn: The host-generated speaker control identity must match its recorded session and confirmed principal before and after poll or authorize. An expired return suppresses the output and preserves an unacknowledged claim.
corrections.cameraAndVoiceIdentity: Camera or voice recognition is not an authentication credential. Personal features for children stay closed pending verified guardian authorization, separate scope and separate acceptance.

verification.fixtureSchemaInstaller: Current checkout schema installer used only in the disposable test snapshot for the existing context/erasure fixtures.
regressions: Imported instructions cannot expose an existing private interest or cause a group effect.
Explicit household route remains available while a generic tool without shared authority is refused.
Both private-result poll and authorize recheck speaker confirmation, including expiry during the return.
Direct dashboard voice retains its distinct authenticated route.
Existing tests cover group opt-in, sender/device substitution, stream revocation, scoped STOP and erased source exclusion.
